notes: Name-level manifest for the native libc C ABI.  Layout, signature and errno values are in docs/spec/native-libc.md.
class is one of posix-2024, xsi, extension, compat-only or unsupported.
v1=false means the name is documented but not promised by the v1 native profile.
The Rust std audit (tools/std-abi-surface.py) reads this file; see that tool's --help for its limits.
